entities.summary: Charles Stanislas Marion was a French general of the First French Empire during the Napoleonic Wars. He started his military service in 1776. He was promoted to general de brigade in 1805. He was killed in action at the Battle of Borodino. He was the father of Charles Louis François Marion, 3rd Baron and grandfather of Charles Louis Raoul Marion, 4th Baron.
